externalReview.target: Econometrie en Operationele Research, Erasmus University Rotterdam, Dutch full-time bachelor, fixed 2026–2027 route, neutral Econometrics major.
externalReview.sourceEditionFinding: The current public study-programme page visibly previews 2027–2028 and cannot prove the older component list. The 2026–2027 OER, English TER and transition regulations control the fixed route. They establish a 180-EC degree, one third-year major, minor/exchange/internship and elective space, ethics, career skills and a 10-EC thesis; 2022–2026 transition entries are not applicable and earlier replacements account for the retained component names/credits.

conditions: The thesis follows the selected major and requires the major seminar/workgroup to have been passed.
Zero-credit guidance is a condition, not part of the 180 EC.

externalReview.pdfVisualInspection: Visually inspected the 2026–2027 OER structure page and transition-regulation pages showing 2022–2026 not applicable plus the 2021/2020 changes. Visible PDF text was used; hidden obsolete layers were not combined with the current public curriculum.

academicReview.definingSubstance: A mathematically intensive econometrics/operations-research degree integrating analysis, linear algebra, probability/statistics, programming, optimisation, economics, econometrics, simulation, time series and a major-aligned thesis.
academicReview.programmeChallenge: Coherence alone is insufficient. The three retained UCR programmes are defensible only because their actual 24-course schedules combine substantial mathematics, statistics, programming and economics with genuine econometrics and, where claimed, optimisation/data-science/finance context. They remain qualified alternatives rather than equivalents.
academicReview.rejectedDirection: Quantitative Logistics was not constructed: the UCR workbook offers no adequate logistics or supply-chain course sequence, so interest row 688 cannot manufacture a fourth programme.
academicReview.limitations: UCR offers only one dedicated econometrics course and does not reproduce the specialist advanced-econometrics, time-series, mathematical-economics, simulation or dedicated econometrics-thesis sequence. The data-science and finance programmes are directions within broader liberal-arts study, not the corresponding EUR majors.

courseReview.inspectionMethod: Opened the enriched workbook profile, prerequisites and term offerings for every distinct selected course, then replayed every one of the 72 placements against the workbook.

decisiveProfiles.BENECON312: Genuine econometrics: OLS/GLS/IV, tests, causal and predictive uses, Monte Carlo work and Stata.
decisiveProfiles.DISARIN311: Genuine search, constraint, linear/nonlinear and convex optimisation, but in an AI-oriented frame.
decisiveProfiles.BENBUSI211: Business/economic implications of AI; retained as context, not represented as technical data science.
decisiveProfiles.BENBUSI112: Accounting and financial-statement context; not claimed as econometrics or quantitative finance.
decisiveProfiles.BENGATE101: Entrepreneurship/business-planning context; not claimed as specialist quantitative finance.
